notes.subject: השפילו
notes.rationale: 'They humbled (thee)' vs 'they are cast down' — KJV 'when men are cast down', JPS 'when they cast thee down'; I follow the reading with an object supplied.

notes.subject: i
notes.rationale: Object pronoun 'thee' supplied; Hebrew השפילו carries no explicit object.

notes.subject: גוה
notes.rationale: גוה is 'haughtiness/lifting up' as a noun; rendered as the quoted cry “sanfɛdɔ bɛ yen” (there is lifting up).

notes.subject: i
notes.rationale: Direct address to Job, Eliphaz's speech continuing.

translation: Sabu u y'i bila duguma, i na kuma ko: “Sanfɛdɔ bɛ yen”; mɔgɔw minnu ka ɲɛ bɛ sigi duguma, Yawe bɛ u lasigi.
